title: gbounce config export
description: Schema for the JSON body emitted by `gbounce config export` and consumed by `gbounce config import`. Cross-product cousin to kbounce + dbounce + ibounce config schemas; the top-level `product` field gates per-product import refusal. G-Slice 1 captures the runtime-config surface (mode + bind defaults + audit-log path); profile / rule / task sections are absent and reported via the `*_supported` fields so cross-product re-import logic stays simple.

product.description: Product name. Must be "gbounce" for a gbounce import.

gbounce_version.description: Version of the gbounce binary that produced the export.

exported_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp the export was generated.

source_hostname_hash.description: First 12 hex chars of sha256(hostname). Lets a reviewer correlate two exports as coming from the same host without leaking the hostname itself.

profiles_supported.description: False in G-Slice 1: gbounce does not yet have a profile subsystem. Reported explicitly so cross-product re-import logic can skip the section without ambiguity.

rules_supported.description: False in G-Slice 1: gbounce does not yet have a global-rules-table subsystem.

tasks_supported.description: False in G-Slice 1: gbounce does not yet have a tasks subsystem.

alert_rules_supported.description: False in G-Slice 1: gbounce does not yet have an alert-rules subsystem.

mcp_install_history_supported.description: False in G-Slice 1: gbounce does not yet ship an MCP-server install path.

runtime_config.description: Runtime-config snapshot (mode + bind defaults + audit-log path).

audit_webhook.description: Audit-webhook channel configuration. Token + URL are masked when --redact-secrets (default) was in effect; the `redacted` flag records which mode was used. G-Slice 1 does not yet ship a webhook pusher; this block round-trips operator intent only.

license.description: License pointer. Bytes are NEVER emitted; license_id + expires_at are round-tripped when present.

audit_prompts.description: Optional captured prompts (only when --include-prompts was passed at export time).

audit_tail.description: Optional tail of the local decisions audit log (only when --include-audit was passed). Bodies / tokens are never included.
